title: Refactor Mistral Vibe Session Analysis & Plugin Logs

questions.prompt: Which Mistral Vibe storage formats should the provider support?
questions.description: Mistral Vibe 3.0+ uses a unified chunk-based store format (`~/.vibe/logs/session/unified/`), while older versions used flat folders (`session_YYYYMMDD_...`) with `meta.json` and `messages.jsonl`.

options.label: Dual support: Auto-detect both modern unified store (v1) and legacy messages.jsonl formats
Modern unified store only: Ingest only ~/.vibe/logs/session/unified/ sessions

questions.prompt: How should subagent and plugin child sessions (`child-*`) be represented?
questions.description: Plugins (such as `ruby-dev`) execute subagents (e.g. specifier, implementer, cleaner, hardener, verifier) as separate child sessions linked via parentSessionId.

options.label: Separate linked sessions: Store child sessions as distinct records with parent_session_id and namespaced agent_type (e.g., ruby-dev:verifier)
Bundled into parent: Merge child messages directly into parent session transcripts
Hybrid: Ingest child sessions as separate linked records and support recursive bundling during analysis

questions.prompt: What plugin-specific telemetry should be extracted from ~/.vibe/logs/session/plugins/?
questions.description: Vibe maintains plugin state in `~/.vibe/logs/session/plugins/` (per-session data, cached packages, manifests). What should be extracted into session models?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Detect active plugins and attribute subagents to their parent plugin package.

options.label: Plugin Identification: Detect and record active plugins loaded during the session in session metadata
Subagent Attribution: Attribute child sessions to their defining plugin in agentType (e.g. ruby-dev:implementer)
Plugin Storage: Scan per-session plugin directories (~/.vibe/logs/session/plugins/data/<session_id>/) for custom logs or artifacts

questions.prompt: How should active / currently running sessions in ~/.vibe/logs/session/active/ be handled?
questions.description: Unified sessions generate snapshot checkpoints while running, and lockfiles reside in active/. Should Code Insights sync active sessions or wait for completion?

options.label: Quiescent/completed only: Only sync sessions marked quiescent or whose lock has cleared
Sync active snapshots: Ingest latest snapshot even while session is active, updating on subsequent syncs
